exec /bin/sh -c 's=${SHELL:-/bin/sh}; case "$s" in *zsh) m=z ;; *bash) m=b ;; *) m=n ;; esac; d=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/etty-$$; if [ "$m" = n ]; then exec "$s" -l; fi; mkdir -m 700 "$d" 2>/dev/null || exec "$s" -l; ETTY_TMPDIR=$d; export ETTY_TMPDIR; if [ "$m" = z ]; then printf "%s\n" "if [ -f \"\$HOME/.zshenv\" ]; then . \"\$HOME/.zshenv\"; fi" > "$d/.zshenv.$$" && mv -f "$d/.zshenv.$$" "$d/.zshenv"; printf "%s\n" "if [ -f \"\$HOME/.zprofile\" ]; then . \"\$HOME/.zprofile\"; fi" > "$d/.zprofile.$$" && mv -f "$d/.zprofile.$$" "$d/.zprofile"; printf "%s\n" "if [ -f \"\$HOME/.zlogin\" ]; then . \"\$HOME/.zlogin\"; fi" > "$d/.zlogin.$$" && mv -f "$d/.zlogin.$$" "$d/.zlogin"; printf "%s\n" "if [ -f \"\$HOME/.zshrc\" ]; then . \"\$HOME/.zshrc\"; fi" "autoload -Uz add-zsh-hook" "_etty_emit() { if [ -n \"\$TMUX\" ]; then printf \"\\033Ptmux;\\033\\033%s\\033\\\\\" \"\$1\"; else printf \"\\033%s\" \"\$1\"; fi; }" "_etty_cwd() { _etty_emit \"\$(printf \"]7;file://%s\\007\" \"\$PWD\")\"; }" "_etty_pre() { _etty_emit \"\$(printf \"]133;C\\007\")\"; }" "_etty_post() { _etty_emit \"\$(printf \"]133;A\\007\")\"; }" "_etty_node() { _etty_emit \"\$(printf \"]6973;node=%s\\007\" \"\${commands[node]}\")\"; }" "add-zsh-hook precmd _etty_cwd" "add-zsh-hook preexec _etty_pre" "add-zsh-hook precmd _etty_post" "add-zsh-hook precmd _etty_node" "zshexit() { rm -rf \"\$ETTY_TMPDIR\"; }" "_etty_cwd" "_etty_node" > "$d/.zshrc.$$" && mv -f "$d/.zshrc.$$" "$d/.zshrc"; ZDOTDIR=$d; export ZDOTDIR; exec "$s" -l; else printf "%s\n" "if [ -f \"\$HOME/.bash_profile\" ]; then . \"\$HOME/.bash_profile\"; elif [ -f \"\$HOME/.bashrc\" ]; then . \"\$HOME/.bashrc\"; fi" "_etty_emit() { if [ -n \"\$TMUX\" ]; then printf \"\\033Ptmux;\\033\\033%s\\033\\\\\" \"\$1\"; else printf \"\\033%s\" \"\$1\"; fi; }" "_etty_cwd() { _etty_emit \"\$(printf \"]7;file://%s\\007\" \"\$PWD\")\"; _etty_emit \"\$(printf \"]6973;node=%s\\007\" \"\$(type -P node)\")\"; _etty_emit \"\$(printf \"]133;A\\007\")\"; }" "_etty_pre() { case \"\$BASH_COMMAND\" in _etty_cwd*) return ;; esac; _etty_emit \"\$(printf \"]133;C\\007\")\"; }" "PROMPT_COMMAND=_etty_cwd" "trap _etty_pre DEBUG" "trap \"rm -rf \\\"\$ETTY_TMPDIR\\\"\" EXIT" > "$d/rc.$$" && mv -f "$d/rc.$$" "$d/rc"; exec "$s" --rcfile "$d/rc" -i; fi'
